final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.ordertypedist AS otd, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT otd AS otd, AVG(avg_short) AS avg_short2 FROM s1 GROUP BY otd) SELECT s1.transref, s1.otd, s1.avg_short, s1.avg_opt, CASE WHEN s2.avg_short2 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s1.avg_short * 1.0 / s2.avg_short2 END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.otd = s2.otd ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
